title: E27 incident-pipe demolition order is not directly asserted (count only)
detail: The atomic-batch test asserts pipe_count==0 (a count), never the incident-pipe ORDER. apply_demolish_node tombstones idempotently with no per-pipe event, so order is state-unobservable; the replay keystone can catch non-determinism but not a deterministic wrong-order regression.
recommended_fix: P3 latent gap, no current defect (slot-order loop + monotonic ids hold the contract). When slice-3 adds per-incident-pipe severance events, assert the emitted pipe-id sequence is ascending id order.
